moq.value: Low MOQ is available on selected models, typically from around 200 pcs. Custom colors and more complex customization may require higher MOQs, commonly from around 500 pcs depending on the product and production process.

productionLeadTime.value: Production lead time depends on the level of customization. Selected stock-color models with standard logo customization may be completed in approximately 7–10 days after artwork approval, while custom colors, complex full-wrap printing, custom packaging or multi-variant projects require a project-specific schedule and can take significantly longer. Final production timing is confirmed after product specifications, quantity, artwork, colors and packaging requirements are reviewed.
productionLeadTime.notes: The 60–70 day schedule belongs only to the active US project and is not a universal promise.

packagingSupport.notes: Availability depends on product, quantity and packaging design.

qualityControlResponsibility.value: HDS coordinates product-specific quality control with manufacturing partners across pre-production confirmation, production follow-up and pre-shipment review. The exact inspection scope is confirmed by product and project.
